headline: World Liberty Financial Plans Token Buyback Following 66% Year-to-Date Drop
summary: Crypto venture World Liberty Financial plans to use fees generated from its USD1 stablecoin reserves to purchase its tokens after a 66% year-to-date decline.
why: World Liberty Financial is a cryptocurrency business backed by Donald Trump that operates decentralized finance products and stablecoins.

impacts.name: World Liberty Financial
impacts.why: The venture plans token buybacks funded by stablecoin reserve fees to support governance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
